# MXD Mainnet Oracle Set

The 5 Dilithium5 (FIPS 204 ML-DSA-87) public keys authorized by the MXD
mainnet chain to attest to BSC bridge deposits. Any bridge mint transaction
must carry a quorum (currently 3-of-5) of valid signatures from these keys
over the canonical message defined in [MXD-API-01](standards/MXD-API-01-bridge-oracle-attestation.md).

These keys are also stored on-chain via the `UPDATE_ORACLE_SET` admin
transaction; a node bootstrapping from genesis discovers the same set without
needing this file. This document exists for off-chain auditors and
implementers who want to verify the on-chain state independently.

## Key format

- **Algorithm:** Dilithium5 (FIPS 204 ML-DSA-87)
- **Public key:** 2592 bytes = 5184 hex characters
- **Signature:** 4627 bytes = 9254 hex characters
- **Derived address:** SHA-3-256(pubkey)[0..20], 40 hex characters (legacy 20-byte form)

## Verification

Each signature in an `oracles[]` array entry is verified by every MXD node
during block validation. The canonical message signed is:

```
"MXD-BRG-V1\0" (11 bytes) ||
algo_id (1 byte) ||
bridge_contract (64 bytes) ||
source_chain_id (32 bytes, first 4 bytes are BE u32) ||
source_tx_hash (32 bytes) ||
source_block_number (8 bytes, BE u64) ||
recipient (32 bytes, addr32 per MXD-01 §4) ||
amount (8 bytes, BE u64) ||
mxd_chain_id (32 bytes, derived from genesis hash)
```

Total: 220 bytes. See [MXD-API-01 §6](standards/MXD-API-01-bridge-oracle-attestation.md)
for the full specification and signing rules.
